The test image shows a soybean **leaf** with scattered, discrete lesions — tan/light brown centers with reddish-brown margins. This points to the leaf disease group (16 candidates). Top candidates: **Frogeye_leaf_spot** (gray center, reddish-brown margin), **Phyllosticta_leaf_spot** (tan/brown with purplish margins), **Septoria_brown_spot** (dark brown irregular lesions).

Let me view one reference from each top candidate first.
I need one more reference. Let me check Brown_Stem_Rot leaf symptoms.

**Summary of analysis:**

- **Test image**: Dark green soybean leaf, upper surface. 6-8 scattered discrete lesions, oval/irregular shape, moderate size. Each lesion has a light tan/pinkish-brown center with a clear darker reddish-brown margin. No yellow halo, no powdery coating, no water soaking, no interveinal pattern.

**Reference comparisons:**
- **Frogeye leaf spot** (Dise_6): Closest match — discrete circular lesions with gray-tan centers and reddish-brown borders on green leaf. Pattern and color scheme align well.
- **Phyllosticta leaf spot**: References showed marginal necrosis and large coalesced lesions — different from the scattered discrete spots.
- **Septoria brown spot**: Dark brown spots on yellowing leaves — different color and context.
- **Bacterial Pustule**: Tiny uniform reddish specks, much smaller and denser.
- **Cercospora**: Dense reddish-purple spots covering the whole leaf.
- **Soybean rust**: Very tiny uniform pustules all over — not discrete like test image.
- **SDS / Brown Stem Rot**: Interveinal necrosis pattern — completely different.
- All others (Downy mildew, Bacterial blight, Vein necrosis, Anthracnose) clearly don't match.

The test image best matches **Frogeye_leaf_spot**: discrete oval/circular lesions with tan-gray centers and reddish-brown margins on a healthy green leaf — the textbook presentation of this disease.
